71fc9dcff677f80d43ef3cb7c767806513c438a4 in public run37238572256; their
qualification is not a native proof verdict for this new source.

The original nineteen lifecycle files and all other qualified source71fc payload
files remain byte-identical. Only NativeProofSmokeControls.cs and SharedNativeRuns.cs
change. New source adds NativeSmokeQualification, NativeProofSession, the external
strict inspector, these notes, the reviewed English plan and its qualification

NativeProofSmokeControls.Run now requires the exact historical qualification ZIP,
rather than an approval boolean. It captures bounded ZIP bytes, validates the

The new actual DLL, deps, runtimeconfig and source-manifest are captured before

NativeProofSession permits exactly six serial, single-use ordinals in this order:

A failed admission, invocation, collection, evidence check or completion poisons

Unknown, missing logs, zero batches and unexpected failures are rejected.

For every solver launch, the inspector binds cleanup, complete and captured-stream
